dependencyRule: public -> released/versioned artifact -> private; reverse dependency forbidden

OPEN: reference provider adapters and self-hostable provider-policy primitives
SHARED_CONTRACT: SDK stable APIs and release artifacts
PRIVATE_TARGET: managed cloud authority and revocation service
global trust registry and reputation graph
marketplace, licensing, billing and enterprise control plane
private production operations and operator workflows

d200.rule: D-200 scripts, benchmark logic and evidence remain public. Only shared-contract compatibility changes require a linked private PR; managed routing intelligence is private.

migrationGate.reason: The current managed coordinator imports the self-hostable public authority kernel. Moving it before publishing a stable authority-kernel contract would require forbidden source/path coupling or turn the private repository into a source snapshot.

exceptionPolicy: Exact allowlist only. No new PRIVATE_TARGET implementation may be added to TRUYN Open. Exceptions must shrink to zero as versioned public contracts become available.
